description: This file defines a custom exception class named ConnectionLimitAutoConfigException, which extends RuntimeException, used to indicate failure in auto-configuration of connection limits within the Eclipse Hono service limiting component.

classes.name: ConnectionLimitAutoConfigException
classes.description: Custom runtime exception indicating failure of auto-configuration of connection limits.

methods.name: ConnectionLimitAutoConfigException
methods.description: Constructor that creates a new exception with a specified detail message.
